span.p:
1. OXC Parser (oxc_parser)
- Produces AST with source tracking
- Handles TS syntax extensions
- Supports decorators, JSX, ES

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. OXC Semantic Analysis (oxc_semantic)
- Symbol resolution and scope analysis
- Binding and reference tracking
- Type checking (scope-level)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. OXC Transformer (oxc_transformer)
- Decorator lowering
- Class field transformations
- Type annotation stripping
- JSX transformation
- Target ES version lowering

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. OXC Code Generator (oxc_codegen)
- JavaScript source output
- Source map generation
- (Optional) OXC Minifier
